mentions.note: newcomer senior; won Club Championships seniors

won 3000m at Ewell Court; 3rd 1500m and 2nd 3000m Southern League Brighton; club record at Southern League Brighton; 1500m and 3000m; improved her own 3000m club record at Aldershot (23 July), first Belgravian to win the event; 1500m and 3000m in the Lily League and Southern League; lowered her own club 3000m record again at Parliament Hill Fields; won 1500m and 3000m at Parliament Hill Fields
Southend 5 Miles 52.44; position printed '46'; 4th 3 Kms Ladies 17.35

mentions.note: 5th seniors 5000m walk 29.23, 1½ minutes off previous best
represented Surrey at Southern Womens Inter Counties; won Surrey 3000m; cut over a minute off her 3000m record
broke own 3000m club record by some 24 seconds; won Seniors 1500m 5:06.7 and 3000m 10:33.6
won 1500m 4:46.2 London Borough heats; 8th Southern Womens Inter-Counties for Surrey in club record 10:02.2
first Belgrave woman to win individually in the Surrey League Cross Country Championships; 3rd individual over the 4 Surrey League races
student at Whitelands College; 1984 improved 1500m 5.17 to 4.45 and 3000m 11.07 to 10.02; won Surrey County Senior 3000m 1984; represented Surrey in Inter-Counties C.C. 1985
2nd Surrey Senior Ladies 3000m 1985 despite viral complaint
Ladies Track & Field and Cross Country captain
